filesystem.detail: Three restores retained source hashes, prepared marker, permissions and symlink, plus installed dependencies without another npm ci.

processes.detail: Container capture explicitly stopped and restarted its source; the source listener was absent after restart and its server received a fresh nonce when relaunched. Each filesystem restore had no listener, then a distinct nonce after explicitly starting a server.

isolation.detail: After all controls finished, each branch retained its expected patched hashes and a distinct marker; the source marker stayed absent and its tracked files stayed unchanged.

jobReattachment.detail: After initial session output, the first polling client detached. A new Daytona SDK client recovered the same session and command IDs, exit 0 and retained stdout, then read remaining bytes from the saved offset. Live stream disconnection, server SSE replay and dashboard reconnection were not exercised.

previewRevocation.detail: 4 previews worked with the retained credential before cleanup; after exact API-confirmed sandbox absence, three matched probes per URL with and without that credential returned HTTP 401/403 (access denied) or 404/410 (route absent). This does not establish independent token invalidation or physical storage deletion.

previewTokenInvalidation.detail: After source restart, the retained token returned HTTP 401/403 while a fresh token returned HTTP 200 for the same preview URL.
